يبرغشش (form IVq)
# يَبْرَغْشِشْ (yabraḡšiš) /jab.raɣ.ʃiʃ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
# يُبْرَغْشَشْ (yubraḡšaš) /jub.raɣ.ʃaʃ/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
